verdict.rationale: Fly.io's marketing says Machines boot in under a second and "scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives" [fly-io-docs-14]. Sprites can sleep until needed and wake on demand [fly-io-docs-5]. However, the only concretely documented scaling mechanism is the `fly scale` command [fly-io-docs-24], which reads as manual horizontal and vertical scaling, not an automatic load-driven policy. missing for 10: documented load/metrics-based autoscaling configuration (triggers, thresholds, min/max limits), evidence of automatic scale-out during real traffic bursts, independent or hands-on corroboration of burst absorption.
